crossRefs.note: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not…
But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
translations.bsb: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”
translations.kjv: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
translations.asv: So he cometh to Simon Peter. He saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
